Questions

Straight answers.

What owners ask first, including the questions where the answer is no.

The race

Is the race really free?

Yes. No card, and no call needed. We read public Google listings and reviews: yours and the three shops a homeowner sees first near you.

Who are the three shops?

The three businesses a homeowner sees first when they search your trade near you on Google Maps. The search and the date are on screen, so you can check it.

What do I get?

Your rating, review count, last 90 days and replies next to theirs, three things you're missing, and replies written for up to three of your reviews.

Why do you ask for my email?

The preview needs nothing. Your first name and email open the full race and send you a copy, with the occasional tip. Unsubscribe any time.

Will you call me?

Only if you book a call. Your race and your replies are yours either way.

Getting started

Is Rempo software I have to run?

No. Rempo is a service. You do four things once, then our team runs it from the job software you already use. You see the work every month.

Does it work with my job software?

We connect to the software you log jobs in as part of setup. Jobs on paper or in a spreadsheet? Book a 15-minute call and we'll talk it through.

When do requests start?

Email requests can start once your software is connected. Texts start once carrier registration clears, which usually takes about a week.

What does it cost?

A monthly plan with a one-time setup, and each location is priced on its own. We'll go through the numbers on your call. {TBD · the offer is being decided, in site.offer}

Results

Will you guarantee more reviews or a higher ranking?

No. We control asking every customer and answering every review. How many review, and where Google ranks you, aren't ours to promise. We track both monthly.

What will I see each month?

A report sent to you: requests sent, reviews in, replies posted, and calls from your Google profile.

I've paid a marketing company before and got nothing.

Rempo runs one thing, your Google reviews, from your own job data, and shows you the numbers every month: requests sent, reviews in, replies posted.

The hard ones

My job software already sends review requests.

That switch sends a request. Nobody runs it. We run the whole program: requests, one reminder, a reply written for each review, and a monthly report.

Will texts annoy my customers?

One request after the job and at most one reminder. Anyone can reply STOP and they won't hear from us again.

Is this allowed by Google?

Yes, the way we run it: the same request to everyone. No screening out unhappy customers, no rewards, no asking them to name a technician or what to write.

Can you remove a bad review?

No. You get an alert the day it posts, and a calm reply is written for it, so you can decide whether to call the customer first.
